category_title.ar: أفعال المرافعة القضائية والمناظرة البرلمانية والإقناع البلاغي
category_title.en: C2 Forensic Oratory, Parliamentary Debate & Persuasive Dialectics Verbs

items.arabic: يَتَرَافَعُ قَضَائِيًّا / يُدَافِعُ بِحَمَاسَةٍ عَنْ قَضِيَّةٍ أَوْ مَوْقِفٍ
items.english: to plead in court / advocate passionately for a cause

example_sentence.de: Der Strafverteidiger plädierte mit bestechender juristischer Logik auf vollständigen Freispruch seines Mandanten.
example_sentence.ar: تَرَافَعَ مُحَامِي الدِّفَاعِ بِمَنْطِقٍ قَانُونِيٍّ آسِرٍ مُطَالِبًا بِالبَرَاءَةِ التَّامَّةِ لِمُوَكِّلِهِ.
example_sentence.en: The defense attorney pleaded for his client's complete acquittal with compelling legal logic.

items.arabic: يَرُدُّ عَلَى مُرَافَعَةِ الخَصْمِ / يُعَقِّبُ تَفْنِيدًا فِي المَحْكَمَةِ
items.english: to reply to an opposing pleading / counterplead

example_sentence.de: Die Staatsanwältin replizierte unverzüglich auf die Ausführungen der Gegenseite mit neuen Beweismitteln.
example_sentence.ar: عَقَّبَتِ النَّائِبَةُ العَامَّةُ عَلَى الفَوْرِ عَلَى دُفُوعِ الخَصْمِ مُسْتَنِدَةً إِلَى أَدِلَّةٍ إِثْبَاتِيَّةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: The prosecutor immediately replied to the opposing side's arguments with fresh evidence.

items.arabic: يُقَدِّمُ التَّعْقِيبَ الثَّانِيَ / يَرُدُّ عَلَى جَوَابِ المُدَّعِي
items.english: to submit a rejoinder / answer a reply in pleadings

example_sentence.de: Im Zivilprozess nutzte der Beklagte sein Recht, auf die Replik der Klägerin detailliert zu duplizieren.
example_sentence.ar: مَارَسَ المُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ فِي الدَّعْوَى المَدَنِيَّةِ حَقَّهُ فِي تَقْدِيمِ التَّعْقِيبِ الثَّانِي المُفَصَّلِ عَلَى رَدِّ المُدَّعِيَةِ.
example_sentence.en: In civil litigation, the defendant exercised his right to submit a detailed rejoinder to the plaintiff's reply.

items.arabic: يَسْتَجْوِبُ بَرْلَمَانِيًّا / يُسَائِلُ الحُكُومَةَ رَسْمِيًّا
items.english: to interpellate ministers in parliament

example_sentence.de: Die Oppositionsparteien interpellierten den Finanzminister zu den intransparenten Rüstungsausgaben.
example_sentence.ar: اسْتَجْوَبَتْ أَحْزَابُ المُعَارَضَةِ وَزِيرَ المَالِيَّةِ حَوْلَ نَفَقَاتِ التَّسَلُّحِ الَّتِي تَشُوبُهَا الضَّبَابِيَّةُ.
example_sentence.en: The opposition parties formally interpellated the finance minister regarding nontransparent defense expenditures.

items.arabic: يُعَرْقِلُ بَرْلَمَانِيًّا بِالخِطَابِ المَمْدُودِ (الفِيلِيبَاسْتَر)
items.english: to filibuster / obstruct legislation by prolonged speaking

example_sentence.de: Der Senator filibusterte über vierzehn Stunden, um das umstrittene Gesetz vor Fristablauf zu blockieren.
example_sentence.ar: وَاصَلَ عُضْوُ مَجْلِسِ الشُّيُوخِ الخِطَابَةَ لِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَاعَةً لِعَرْقَلَةِ القَانُونِ المُثِيرِ لِلْجَدَلِ.
example_sentence.en: The senator filibustered for over fourteen hours to derail the controversial bill before the deadline.

items.arabic: يُبْطِلُ الحُجَّةَ / يَدْحَضُ الشُّبُهَاتِ وَالأَدِلَّةَ
items.english: to invalidate or refute an argument

example_sentence.de: Mit unwiderlegbaren Dokumenten entkräftete die Zeugin alle falschen Anschuldigungen der Anklage.
example_sentence.ar: أَبْطَلَتِ الشَّاهِدَةُ بِوَثَائِقَ قَاطِعَةٍ كُلَّ الادِّعَاءَاتِ البَاطِلَةِ لِطَرَفِ الِاتِّهَامِ.
example_sentence.en: With irrefutable documents, the witness completely invalidated all false accusations of the prosecution.

items.arabic: يُسَلِّمُ لِلْخَصْمِ بِنُقْطَةٍ جَدَلِيَّةٍ لِاحْتِوَاءِ حُجَّتِهِ
items.english: to concede a rhetorical point to gain upper hand

example_sentence.de: Der Debattierer konzedierte geschickt eine Teilschuld, um die verbleibende Hauptanklage umso wirksamer zu zerstreuen.
example_sentence.ar: سَلَّمَ المُنَاظِرُ بِذَكَاءِ الخَطِيبِ بِجُزْءٍ مِنَ الخَطَأِ لِيَتَمَكَّنَ مِنْ دَحْضِ التُّهْمَةِ الرَّئِيسَةِ بِفَاعِلِيَّةٍ أَكْبَرَ.
example_sentence.en: The debater strategically conceded a partial flaw in order to dismantle the core allegation more decisively.

items.arabic: يُسَاجِلُ بَلَاغِيًّا / يَخُوضُ نِزَالًا كَلَامِيًّا حَتَّى النِّهَايَةِ
items.english: to fight out a verbal duel to the finish

example_sentence.de: Die beiden Parteiführer fochten das Duell um die Kanzlerschaft live vor Millionen Fernsehzuschauern aus.
example_sentence.ar: خَاضَ زَعِيمَا الحِزْبَيْنِ النِّزَالَ البَلَاغِيَّ عَلَى المُنَاصَفَةِ حَوْلَ المَنْصِبِ مُبَاشَرَةً أَمَامَ مَلَايِينِ المُشَاهِدِينَ.
example_sentence.en: Both party leaders fought out their high-stakes rhetorical duel live before millions of television viewers.

items.arabic: يُسَاجِلُ هُجُومِيًّا / يُهَاجِمُ بِحِدَّةٍ وَقَسْوَةٍ فِي الخِطَابِ
items.english: to polemicize fiercely

example_sentence.de: Der Publizist polemisierte schonungslos gegen die geplante Steuererhöhung der Regierungskoalition.
example_sentence.ar: سَاجَلَ الكَاتِبُ بِحِدَّةٍ بَالِغَةٍ ضِدَّ الزِّيَادَةِ الضَّرِيبِيَّةِ المُرْتَقَبَةِ مِنَ الائْتِلَافِ الحَاكِمِ.
example_sentence.en: The columnist polemicized ruthlessly against the governing coalition's proposed tax hike.

items.arabic: يَسْتَصْرِخُ الوِجْدَانَ / يُنَاشِدُ الضَّمِيرَ وَالعَقْلَ
items.english: to appeal passionately to conscience or reason

example_sentence.de: In einer bewegenden Rede appellierte der Delegierte an das Verantwortungsbewusstsein der versammelten Staatengemeinschaft.
example_sentence.ar: نَاشَدَ المَنْدُوبُ فِي خِطَابٍ مُؤَثِّرٍ حِسَّ المَسْؤُولِيَّةِ لَدَى الأُسْرَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ المُجْتَمِعَةِ.
example_sentence.en: In a moving address, the delegate appealed to the sense of responsibility of the assembled nations.

items.arabic: يُصِرُّ وَيُلِحُّ عَلَى النُّقْطَةِ الحِجَاجِيَّةِ
items.english: to insist adamantly upon a point
collocations: auf der Einhaltung von Vereinbarungen insistieren

example_sentence.de: Die Journalistin insistierte hartnäckig auf einer eindeutigen Stellungnahme des Ministers zur Affäre.
example_sentence.ar: أَلَحَّتِ الصَّحَفِيَّةُ بِإِصْرَارٍ عَلَى الحُصُولِ عَلَى مَوْقِفٍ وَاضِحٍ مِنَ الوَزِيرِ حَوْلَ القَضِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: The journalist adamantly insisted on an unambiguous statement from the minister regarding the scandal.

items.arabic: يُعَزِّزُ الحُجَّةَ وَيَدْعَمُهَا بِأَدِلَّةٍ دَامِغَةٍ
items.english: to substantiate or buttress an argument

example_sentence.de: Der Sachverständige untermauerte sein Gutachten mit umfassenden statistischen Erhebungen.
example_sentence.ar: عَزَّزَ الخَبِيرُ تَقْرِيرَهُ الفَنِّيَّ بِبَيَانَاتٍ إِحْصَائِيَّةٍ شَامِلَةٍ وَقَاطِعَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: The expert witness substantiated his testimony with comprehensive statistical surveys.

items.arabic: يَعْتَرِضُ / يُبْدِي دَفْعًا أَوْ مَأْخَذًا حِجَاجِيًّا
items.english: to object or raise an objection

example_sentence.de: Dagegen lässt sich berechtigterweise einwenden, dass die Kosten den tatsächlichen Nutzen weit übersteigen.
example_sentence.ar: يُمْكِنُ الاعتِرَاضُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ بِحَقٍّ بِأَنَّ التَّكَالِيفَ تَتَجَاوَزُ المَنْفَعَةَ الفِعْلِيَّةَ بِمَرَاحِلَ.
example_sentence.en: Against this, one can legitimately object that the expenditures far outweigh the tangible benefits.

items.arabic: يُعَارِضُ وَيُجَابِهُ المَوْقِفَ رَسْمِيًّا
items.english: to oppose formally

example_sentence.de: Mehrere Ausschussmitglieder opponierten offen gegen den undemokratischen Verfahrensvorschlag.
example_sentence.ar: عَارَضَ عَدَدٌ مِنْ أَعْضَاءِ اللَّجْنَةِ عَلَنًا المُقْتَرَحَ الإِجْرَائِيَّ غَيْرَ الدِّيمُقْرَاطِيِّ.
example_sentence.en: Several committee members openly opposed the undemocratic procedural motion.

items.arabic: يَسْتَنْتِجُ خِتَامِيًّا مِنَ المُقَدِّمَاتِ المَنْطِقِيَّةِ
items.english: to conclude logically from premises

example_sentence.de: Aus den vorgelegten Indizien lässt sich zweifelsfrei konkludieren, dass der Vertrag absichtlich gebrochen wurde.
example_sentence.ar: يُمْكِنُ الاستِنْتَاجُ بِلَا أَدْنَى شَكٍّ مِنَ القَرَائِنِ المَعْرُوضَةِ أَنَّ العَقْدَ قَدْ نُقِضَ عَمْدًا.
example_sentence.en: From the presented circumstantial evidence, one can conclude beyond doubt that the treaty was breached intentionally.

items.arabic: يُهَدِّئُ رَوْعَ الجُمْهُورِ / يُسَكِّنُ الغَضَبَ بَلَاغِيًّا
items.english: to appease or mollify an audience

example_sentence.de: Der Bürgermeister bemühte sich, die besorgten Anwohner mit versöhnlichen Worten zu beschwichtigen.
example_sentence.ar: بَذَلَ عُمْدَةُ المَدِينَةِ وُسْعَهُ لِتَهْدِئَةِ رَوْعِ السُّكَّانِ القَلِقِينَ بِكَلِمَاتٍ تَطْمِينِيَّةٍ رَصِينَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: The mayor endeavored to appease the alarmed residents with soothing and conciliatory words.

items.arabic: يُشْعِلُ الحَمَاسَةَ وَيُلْهِبُ مَشَاعِرَ السَّامِعِينَ
items.english: to inflame passions and inspire enthusiasm
collocations: die Menge für ein Ideal entflammen

example_sentence.de: Mit seiner glühenden Rede entflammte der Reformer die Jugend für den Einsatz für Menschenrechte.
example_sentence.ar: أَلْهَبَ المُصْلِحُ بِخِطَابِهِ الوَهَّاجِ حَمَاسَةَ الشَّبَابِ لِلنِّضَالِ مِنْ أَجْلِ حُقُوقِ الإِنْسَانِ.
example_sentence.en: With his impassioned oration, the reformer inflamed the youth with zeal for human rights.

items.arabic: يَصُدُّ هُجُومَ الخَصْمِ بِبَرَاعَةٍ وَيَرُدُّ الصَّاعَ
items.english: to parry a verbal thrust skillfully

example_sentence.de: Die Spitzenkandidatin parierte den provokanten Einwurf des Journalisten mit elegantem Humor.
example_sentence.ar: صَدَّتِ المُرَشَّحَةُ الرَّئِيسَةُ هُجُومَ الصَّحَفِيِّ الِاسْتِفْزَازِيَّ بِفُكَاهَةٍ أَنِيقَةٍ وَبَرَاعَةٍ فَائِقَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: The lead candidate deftly parried the journalist's provocative thrust with elegant wit.

items.arabic: يُلَمِّحُ دِبْلُومَاسِيًّا لِدَفْعِ الخَصْمِ نَحْوَ التَّنَاقُضِ
items.english: to insinuate rhetorically to trap the opponent

example_sentence.de: Durch eine scheinbar unschuldige Nachfrage insinuierte der Anwalt geschickt einen Widerspruch in der Zeugenaussage.
example_sentence.ar: أَلْمَحَ المُحَامِي بِذَكَاءِ التَّرَافُعِ عَبْرَ سُؤَالٍ بَرِيءٍ ظَاهِرِيًّا إِلَى وُجُودِ تَنَاقُضٍ فِي شَهَادَةِ الشَّاهِدِ.
example_sentence.en: Through a seemingly innocuous follow-up question, the attorney cleverly insinuated a contradiction in the testimony.

items.arabic: يَظْفَرُ بِالإِقْنَاعِ / يُحَقِّقُ النَّجَاحَ الخِطَابِيَّ السَّاحِقَ
items.english: to succeed brilliantly and carry the day
collocations: mit seiner Argumentation vor Gericht reüssieren

example_sentence.de: Mit ihrer glanzvollen Verteidigungsrede reüssierte die Anwältin und errang einen einstimmigen Freispruch.
example_sentence.ar: ظَفِرَتِ المُحَامِيَةُ بِنَجَاحٍ سَاحِقٍ بِمُرَافَعَتِهَا البَاهِرَةِ، حَاصِدَةً حُكْمًا بِالبَرَاءَةِ بِإِجْمَاعِ الآرَاءِ.
example_sentence.en: With her brilliant closing defense, the attorney succeeded triumphantly, securing an absolute acquittal.
